title: Tangent Line to a Twisted Cubic Space Curve
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find parametric equations for the tangent line to the twisted cubic r(t) = <t, t^2, t^3> at the point where t = 1.

steps.title: Evaluate Point on Curve at t = 1
steps.explanation: Substitute t = 1 into the position vector to obtain P_0(1, 1, 1).

steps.title: Compute Tangent Direction Vector
steps.explanation: Differentiate r(t) and evaluate at t = 1.
steps.why: Determining direction vector for tangent line.

steps.title: Write Parametric Equations of Line
steps.explanation: Set up line through (1, 1, 1) in direction <1, 2, 3>.
steps.why: Formulating tangent line in parameter space.
